description: This is a satellite map depicting the coastal lagoon system at Golfo di Signo, Sardinia, Italy, based on European Union 2012 LUCAS (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey) imagery. A significant water body, identified by the label "8.3.1 Lagoons (without reeds)", is delineated by a thick yellow outline. This lagoon exhibits varying water depths or sediment characteristics, appearing in shades of dark blue and lighter blue/white. It is largely separated from the darker blue open sea on the right by a beige/white land barrier, likely a sand spit. To the left, within the coastal area, a series of rectangular, geometrically arranged water and land features (depicted in green, dark blue, and black tones) indicate extensive salt pans or aquaculture facilities. The surrounding terrestrial areas display vegetation (shown in red, typical for infrared imagery) and lighter-coloured barren ground.
